summary: Build the Tactician, Conqueror, and Kensai keyword mechanisms per the user's precise rules text: (1) tactical-advantage, a universal PlayerAbility exempted entirely from the once-per-turn dedupe (a first), discarding a card to give the performing Tactician Force equal to its Focus Value; (2) Conqueror, an automatic ResolveBattle check after an attacker win that straightens one Conqueror-keyword attacking Personality, deferring to a new PendingConqueror/PendingChoice pair when the attacker must pick among two or more, via a new FinishBattleResolution tail shared with the immediate path; (3) Kensai/Kama, AttachmentAllowed now allows two Weapons when the wielder has Kensai (printed or granted) or a Kama is involved, capped at two even when both apply. Training fixtures (training-tactician, training-conqueror, training-kensai, training-weapon, training-kama, training-focus-strategy) prove each ahead of any published card needing it. Shared-file change: docs/ROADMAP.md is the cross-lane living checklist by design; all code changes are rules-lane engine-only, no client files touched.
validation: bash tools/check.sh --skip-client: 77/77 core tests (3 new: TacticalAdvantage, ConquerorStraightensAfterVictory, KensaiAndKamaWeaponCap), 33/33 published, 8/8 deck-format, plus AI/server/client-transport checks -- all pass.
remaining: No published card exercises any of the three yet; no UI surfacing for the new chooseConqueror decision or the enemy-province-style province targeting Tactical Advantage doesn't need but Reconnaissance still does.
